data.title: risk:high Implement measured Temporal WASM v0 client
data.description: Full local Temporal plugin implementation: pinned protobuf generator/descriptor preflight, exact three-operation semantic host client, bounded projection, local-only package checks, explicit Lua polling example and offline real-component harness. Review all source against frozen WIT and Sigil decision contract. This does not approve publication, stable Sigil floor, server compatibility, CAPI acceptance or claimed memory erasure. Five risk:high questions required.

data.body:
[INFO][risk:high] Exact-range security assessment for 5de3b9e..a9aaea4 (tree babfa162): no blocking finding.

1. Failure modes: invalid fields, payload shape, timeout, and local limits fail before the host call (src/client.rs:82-108,231-240,285-355); host faults remain infrastructure/host-failure with Start not-sent versus unknown ambiguity from trusted send-state, nonzero gRPC status remains typed server-status, and malformed/oversize/unsupported responses return no partial result (src/client.rs:388-442,620-803).

2. Edge cases: reviewed inclusive 4 MiB message, 2 MiB payload, 32-entry/8 KiB metadata, 4,096-event, 16-node, and 64 KiB token ceilings; split singular protobuf messages, duplicate metadata wire keys, unknown enum/future fields, signed 64-bit/nanosecond values, raw/external payload rejection, caller-driven pagination, and exact two-shape history policy (src/client.rs:14-20,217-282,468-607,609-803).

3. Rollback: the client/WIT/generated/package surface is newly added in this persisted feature range and has no migration, background task, retry, or connection resource. Reverting/removing the range removes the feature; any possibly sent Start must still be treated from recorded effect as applied/unknown and must never be retried implicitly.

4. Monitoring: consume trusted error kind/code/operation/effect plus server status code/class and Sigil sticky infrastructure state; alert on host-failure, unknown Start effect, malformed/limit/unsupported spikes, and poll exhaustion. Do not log protobuf bodies, payload/status-detail bytes, route/credential material, or reinterpret infrastructure as an expected product RED (src/client.rs:43-73,413-466; examples/lib/temporal_poll.lua:10-26).

5. Validation: static review covered the whole persisted range, exact WIT/contract, production guest paths, generated schema and all exact SHA inventories, package trust claims, Lua helper, and component harness. The existing component at SHA-256 5c4bd1b74284f4825a8e24e08947c9b7dee8abd5e2f8760cb34cd1e44ac29944 statically parses as exactly one sigil:host/grpc-unary import and three sigil:temporal exports (src/lib.rs:25-60; tools/component-conformance/src/main.rs:50-149). No builds/tests/services were run in this review; reported 22 Rust tests + 1 doctest, 7 pack tests, 25 Lua cases, 2 harness helpers, and 12 component calls remain local evidence only.

Non-blocking provenance residual: regeneration checks libprotoc 35.1 and byte-for-byte inventories but --write does not itself refresh recorded protoc/codegen binary hashes (scripts/rebuild-protobuf.sh:50-54,111-121; tools/codegen/provenance.json:3-18). Current hashes are consistent and explicitly initial/local-only; refresh and independently bind generator provenance for any future release regeneration.

Scope separation: conformance/contract.json:3-11 keeps public integration and native CAPI replacement separate. This assessment does not approve publication, a stable Sigil floor, real Temporal compatibility, CAPI acceptance, process-wide erasure, or NativeMini qualification; NativeMini remains pending.

Diagnostics may contain local paths/tool text and are developer output, not attestation.
